definitions.explanation: A situation in which one problem leads to another, which in turn worsens the original problem, creating a self-reinforcing negative loop.

examples.japanese: {悪循環|あくじゅんかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{陥|おちい}る→陥る：14537_ochiiru⟧。
examples.english: To fall into a vicious cycle.

examples.japanese: ⟦{睡眠不足|すいみんぶそく}→睡眠不足：08690_suiminbusoku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦ストレス→ストレス：03827_sutoresu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{悪循環|あくじゅんかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{断|た}ち{切|き}りたい→断ち切る：15043_tachikiru⟧。
examples.english: I want to break the vicious cycle of lack of sleep and stress.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人口|じんこう}{減少|げんしょう}→人口減少：24385_jinkougenshou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧⟦{縮小|しゅくしょう}→縮小：02568_shukushou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{悪循環|あくじゅんかん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{抜|ぬ}け{出|だ}す→抜け出す：06040_nukedasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{容易|ようい}→容易：12316_youi⟧で⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: It is not easy to escape the vicious cycle of population decline and economic contraction.

notes:
USAGE:
The opposite is ⟦{好循環|こうじゅんかん}→好循環：30610_koujunkan⟧ (virtuous cycle). {悪循環|あくじゅんかん} is common in health, economics, social issues, and everyday conversation about recurring problems.

The word breaks down as {悪|あく} (bad) + ⟦{循環|じゅんかん}→循環：08669_junkan⟧ (circulation, cycle).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {悪循環|あくじゅんかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{陥|おちい}る→陥る：14537_ochiiru⟧: to fall into a vicious cycle
- {悪循環|あくじゅんかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{断|た}ち{切|き}る→断ち切る：15043_tachikiru⟧: to break a vicious cycle
- {悪循環|あくじゅんかん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{抜|ぬ}け{出|だ}す→抜け出す：06040_nukedasu⟧: to escape a vicious cycle
- {悪循環|あくじゅんかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{繰|く}り{返|かえ}す→繰り返す：02051_kurikaesu⟧: to repeat a vicious cycle
